relationships.subject: AQP4
relationships.evidence_quote: The changes in AQP4 distribution led to a massive release of CGRP [70].

relationships.subject: Glymphatic system
relationships.evidence_quote: It can been postulated that an impairment of the GS may increase CGRP concentration and thus worsen migraine.

key_findings: Review: glymphatic dysfunction may contribute to migraine via neuroinflammation, CGRP dysregulation and cortical spreading depression, but human evidence is limited and mostly negative.
In NTG migraine mice, reduced perivascular AQP4 was associated with massive CGRP release.
